We start by using the power of product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{(x{y}^{2})}^{2}\cdot xy={x}^{2}\cdot ({y}^{2})^{2}\cdot xy & \end{aligned}
$$

Then, we use the power rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}\cdot ({y}^{2})^{2}\cdot xy & = \\ {x}^{2}\cdot {y}^{2\cdot 2}\cdot xy & = \\ {x}^{2}\cdot {y}^{4}\cdot xy & \end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we use the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}\cdot {y}^{4}\cdot xy & = \\ ({x}^{2}\cdot x)\cdot ({y}^{4}\cdot y) & = \\ {x}^{2+1}\cdot {y}^{4+1} & = \\ {x}^{3}\cdot {y}^{5} & = \\ {x}^{3}{y}^{5} & \end{aligned}
$$
